name: MarketPin Operations
subtitle: Audit MarketPin evidence
description: Diagnose MarketPinPredictor sessions, reconcile dashboard and persisted evidence, audit gamma and prediction provenance, and review market-facing features with explicit freshness, uncertainty, and risk boundaries. This skills-only plugin uses host-provided workspace and Python capabilities when available. It does not place trades, provide individualized investment instructions, hide invalid data, or automatically restart services.
capabilities: Reconcile dashboard, API, audit, and SQLite evidence
Review dashboard trust and market-risk communication
starterPrompts: Check this MarketPinPredictor session and explain whether it is healthy.
Audit this MarketPin gamma or prediction value across UI, API, audit, and SQLite.
Review this MarketPin feature for evidence quality, UX trust, and market-risk communication.
